audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagrees with the packet at two rows. Both layers read Fiora / Skill / Akali / Akali / FIORA / Akali / AKALI; the packet levelChart reads Fiora / Skill / Akali / Akali / Akali / Akali / FIORA. The prose sides with the packet: whys[4] says Perfect Execution lets her dash out of Grand Challenge before all four Vitals land (an Akali row), and whys[6] says a shroud-down Akali loses the honest 1v1 (a Fiora row).
audit.why: The chart's own explanations contradict the sides printed next to them at level 6 and at two items. The packet is corroborated by the prose in both layers.
audit.corrected: win[4] and phases[4] -> Akali 4/10; win[6] and phases[6] -> Fiora 6/10; phases[4].why and phases[5].why rewritten so the reason matches the side.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why claims Ravenous Hydra is your spike and tells you to force fights, but phases[5].side is Akali — the first-item row belongs to her Lich Bane, as spikes[2]/whys[5] correctly say.
audit.why: Akali's first item lands before Fiora's bruiser components come online; telling the player to force fights on the row the enemy owns inverts the advice.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now names Lich Bane and the shroud follow-up.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's ability advice is generic boilerplate: tradeBad and dontsFull[2].d both say only 'your W exists to delete his ONE key spell' without naming which Akali spell is worth parrying, and no cooldown or energy number appears anywhere in the full layer.
audit.why: The decisive interactions are concrete: Twilight Shroud is 20s at rank 1 and makes her untargetable so an in-flight auto drops its target mid-Vital; Shuriken Flip (16s at rank 1) and the Perfect Execution recast are the casts actually worth a Riposte; Five Point Strike costs 110 energy at rank 1, so her poke has a hard floor.
audit.corrected: tradeBad, dontsFull[0..2].d, dosFull[1].d, breakdown.mid and report[5].t now carry the real names, cooldowns and the energy cost.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls Akali 'he'/'his' in tradeGood, breakdown.mid, breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late and dontsFull[0].d.
audit.why: Same defect the mirror audit recorded from Akali's side. Wrong pronouns read as untouched boilerplate and undercut trust in the rest of the page.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in every string edited below.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page tells the player that Akali's opener is an auto-attack reset (Assassin's Mark), so the tell is the empowered-auto wind-up, not a visible ability cast.
audit.why: Fiora players hold Riposte for a spell animation; against Akali the damage arrives on an auto with bonus range after she leaves the passive ring.
audit.corrected: Not written — I could not fit it inside any existing string's length band without dropping a verified cooldown fact. Flagged here instead.

notes: The content layer here was already strong and mostly left alone. The full layer was untouched boilerplate with wrong pronouns and a chart that disagreed with the packet at level 6 and two items.
